_comment: The Grade 1 Computing standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. Eight lessons organised by the strands of Cambridge Primary Computing 0059 Stage 1 (28 objectives), NOT by the units of the Word-pack course under computing/grade-1/data, so progress is written under l01..l08 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. objectiveFloors are recorded at the measured value after each build and may rise, not fall.
subject: computing
hubStrands: Algorithms for everyday tasks: following the steps, putting them in order, spotting the one step that is wrong, giving directions with forward, backwards, left and right, and changing the steps to change what happens.
Turning an algorithm into a program a computer can run; predicting what it will do; running it to test it; finding out why it went wrong; and debugging it.
Asking a computer the right way for different kinds of question; recording answers with a form; reading a data table to answer a question; letting a computer sort and organise.
Devices joined into a network, with wires and without; the internet as many computers joined around the world; and the times when the internet is not there.
What computers are for; one computer running many programs; inputs and outputs; the computers hidden inside everyday things; what a robot is and where robots work.
